name: statistical_power

knowledge_assets.title: Closed-form power recipes
knowledge_assets.purpose: Select and document common closed-form sample-size and detectable-effect calculations.

knowledge_assets.title: Effect-size definitions
knowledge_assets.purpose: Choose an effect-size scale that matches the estimand, outcome, allocation, and planned analysis.

knowledge_assets.title: Simulation-based power
knowledge_assets.purpose: Plan simulation sensitivity analyses for clustered, repeated-measure, nonstandard, or otherwise complex designs.

description: Statistical power is a pre-study planning primitive for sample-size calculation, detectable-effect sensitivity, attrition adjustment, and power analysis matched to experimental design. Use it after selecting a design and before data collection.
capabilities: Calculate or plan sample size for common study designs.
Run sensitivity analyses for detectable effects without using misleading observed-power claims.
Carry design structure, alpha, power, effect size, attrition, and multiplicity assumptions into an analysis handoff.
requirements: Chosen study design, estimand, effect-size definition, alpha, target power, and allocation ratio.
Attrition or missingness assumptions when relevant.
Power-analysis implementation package or executor when numeric calculation is required.
